name: 56560 · Moorhead, MN
findings: ZIP 56560 (Moorhead) has 121 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 56560 (Moorhead) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
